description.value: Pokérrito Dunsmuir is a quick-service poke bowl and sushi burrito restaurant in the heart of downtown Vancouver's Financial District, steps from Granville and Burrard SkyTrain stations. The Pan-Asian concept features sushi-grade salmon and tuna alongside plant-based proteins, with over 50 customizable bowl and burrito combinations. It is a compact urban eatery well-suited for cyclists seeking a fast, build-your-own meal on a busy downtown corridor.
